title: Fountain Square enters Plan Commission review
body: The mixed-use proposal for the Fountain Square block was formally docketed. Status moved from Proposed to In review.

title: Maple Avenue Residences receive approval
body: City Council approved 48 courtyard homes, a third of them income-restricted, on the former surface lot west of the el.

title: Lakefront Pavilion marked complete
body: The restored 1930s shelter reopened for weekend programs. Cedar roof, limestone patching, lake-facing openings returned to daylight.

title: Main Street Lofts filed
body: Twelve work-live studios proposed above retained storefronts on the independent mile. Neighbors are watching the alley.

title: New dispatch: The Square, Reconsidered
body: Our featured story on the Fountain Square file — the quieter tower, the wetter plaza, and the Tuesday night still ahead.
